eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Yakima, WA; at 3:44 PM on AUG 20, 2024 Effective until 6:44 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Level 3 "GO NOW") Evacuation Notice A wildfire is threatening your safety, if you are within the evacuation zone of-1869 Bohosky Drive, NE of Terrace Hights Area Yakima County WA. Get your family and pets in your vehicles and leave now! See https://www.facebook.com/YakimaCountyOEM/ for evacuation boundary.
